title: Simultaneous Linear (3 Unknowns) / Det / Inverse
summary: 3×3 linear system and determinant, plus a 112-byte adjoint for the inverse. REG Lin.

body.text: No FMLA does a 3×3 system. WebCal version II is full Cramer’s rule in REG Lin (no b₁c₂ ≠ b₂c₁ trap). Prompts are row-wise a, b, c, d. First pause is det; then x, y, z. Skip each d with EXE to get only the determinant. Inverse: either solve three times with right-hand sides (1,0,0), (0,1,0), (0,0,1), or type the 112-byte adjoint listing and divide by det. ┘ is a b/c. maxX / maxY / n are S-VAR / S-SUM tokens, not letters.

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: 153 bytes (Cramer) or 112 bytes (adjoint) of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in REG Lin (MODE 6 → 1 → slot → 5 → 1). Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).
Row-major a11…a33. Pauses are adj entries, last pause is det. Inverse = each adjoint entry ÷ det.
Example 1: x + y + z = 6, x − y + 2z = 5, x + 3y + z = 10
Question: Use this program to solve the case: x + y + z = 6, x − y + 2z = 5, x + 3y + z = 10.

items: MODE → 6 → 2 → slot (created in REG Lin, FreqOn)

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: Determinant only.
Given: |1 2 3 ; 7 8 9 ; 6 5 2| = 12. EXE through each right-hand side.

items: Display 12. AC. det is also in X

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: Inverse via adjoint.

items: Each inverse entry is adjoint ÷ 40. MODE 1 when finished with REG

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: FreqOn is SHIFT MODE ◀ ◀ 1. n is SHIFT 1 3. maxX is SHIFT 2 2 2. maxY is SHIFT 2 2 → 2. Σx / Σy / Σxy are SHIFT 1 2, SHIFT 1 → 2, SHIFT 1 → 3. Comma between paired DT values. Math ERROR on Cramer means det = 0. Source: WebCal simultaneous8 and Abjont_1.
